verdict.rationale: kitty documents a remote-control interface for scripts and the shell. Its commands can be run directly, and a hands-on probe showed `kitten @ ls/send-text/get-text` working against a live instance. That makes the reference effectively runnable from a terminal, but it is a static docs page rather than an interactive API explorer, and no OpenAPI/Swagger spec was found. Missing for 10: an interactive in-browser API reference, an OpenAPI or other machine-readable spec, embedded runnable examples in the docs.
